**How do I save my project and come back later**
1. Click "Save / Open" in the top toolbar (SPB Projects). It saves the project zones and layer state plus the source-paint path in one project file. Keep that source available at the saved path to reopen it.
2. To reopen, click "Save / Open" again and load it.
Exact controls: Save / Open (Pro > top toolbar (tool row)); SAVE SHOKK (Pro > left column > ZONES > More (three-dot) menu).
Did that get you there, or is there something else you are trying to do? The SHOKK project stores its zones and layer state, including current layer pixel payload where available, and records the original source path; it does not bundle the original PSD. Keep that source file available at the saved path.

**How do I make something chrome**
1. Your selected zone is "Roof solid green" (zone 1) - click another card in the ZONES list to work on that one instead.
2. Select the zone, BASE > Base Material > Chrome (mirror) or Satin Chrome (softer).
3. Chrome repaints the zone silver. To keep your colours and only get the shine, use a Foundation chrome with "Use source paint (spec only)".
4. In iRacing the paint under a metal part should be near white for chrome to read.
Exact controls: Base Material (Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL > BASE); BASE COLOR dropdown (Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL > BASE > Base Color).

Clearcoat is the B channel of the spec map. It controls the clear reflective coating: lower channel values give stronger gloss (16 is maximum gloss; 0–15 means no clearcoat), while higher values are duller. It changes material response, not the paint color.

**Adjust only clearcoat**
1. Select the roof zone, then adjust the zone input titled “Shift the CLEARCOAT channel (-127..+127)”.
2. Inspect the blue B / COAT preview to check the result. Leave R / METAL and G / ROUGH unchanged if you want to adjust clearcoat alone.
3. The control is a channel offset
